## Description

Helper functions for `OpenMx` models
in R [@RCoreTeam-2026; @Neale-Hunter-Pritikin-etal-2016]:
matrices with labels, bounds, and vectors of free parameters;
covariance matrices from the LDL decomposition with a softplus diagonal;
starting values for vector autoregressive models;
and fitting until the Hessian is positive definite,
with diagnostics and bound handling.
Each exported function has an internal version without input checks
that other projects can copy.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `mxHelper` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/mxHelper) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/mxHelper")
```
